title: A two-dimensional complex with embedding-dimension gap two
strongest_supported_claim: There exists a finite two-dimensional simplicial complex K with e_PL(K)=3 and original-simplex e_lin(K)=5; its first barycentric subdivision has a linear embedding in R3. The proof supplies finite existence parameters n=2^256, p=2^-384, m=2^320, not an explicit generated facet list.
exact_checked_claims: Freely assigned abstract barycentric-subdivision vertices, exact within-facet intersections, finite global distance separation and local angular-cone separation give the first-subdivision R3 embedding.
Balanced seven-point Radon pair via two-dimensional Gale kernel; double counting gives C(n,6)/7 potential witnesses.
All deletions of at most m remove at most mM witnesses; constants c=1/645120 and a=c^2/2 are sufficient.
Whole-triangle Bernoulli variables give ordered off-diagonal dependence p^3 sum d(d-1), with diagonal mu. Primary Janson theorem has the stated denominator and endpoint.
Original Goodman–Pollack finite bound is n^(20n) for labeled simple R4 order types. Signed minors determine all crossing pairs.
Union over every order type and every deletion set supports sample-dependent cleanup; perturbation from arbitrary affine embeddings preserves disjoint-face separation and injectivity.
Collision cleanup leaves a linear family with more than n triangles; its nonplanar one-skeleton proves PL minimum3.
The obstruction forbids original-linear R4 embeddings; moment-curve placement in R5 proves the exact linear minimum5.
All printed finite parameters make the three failure bounds sum to less than one.

primary_interface_notes.application: Pad every triangle with its own private vertex to obtain a linear four-uniform hypergraph and restrict a PL R3 embedding; the manuscript independently proves the stronger first-subdivision result.

primary_interface_notes.scope: Minimum-dimension gap for simplicial complexes generally; no manifold restriction.
Finite bound for labeled simple configurations n>d; d4 yields n^(20n).
Independent Bernoulli ground set, subset-presence events, ordered dependence including diagonal; t=mu allowed.
